units.source_text: 我心想难道我是在做梦嘛！

en.t: I wondered to myself, could I be dreaming?

units.source_text: 我凝神屏气的看着眼前难以置信的景象。

en.t: I held my breath and stared intently at the unbelievable scene before my eyes.

units.source_text: 在摇晃的灯笼透出的昏暗灯光下，手持象牙笏的天皇，

en.t: In the dim light spilling from the swaying lantern, the emperor held an ivory ritual baton,

units.source_text: 头戴璎珞皇冠的皇后，右边的橘子树，左边的樱花树，

en.t: the empress wore a jeweled crown, with an orange tree on the right and a cherry tree on the left,

units.source_text: 举着长柄阳伞的侍女，手持齐眉酒杯的宫女，

en.t: a lady-in-waiting held up a long-handled parasol, and a court lady held a wine cup level with her brows,

units.source_text: 小小的莳绘镜台和柜子，贝壳材质的屏风，食碗，

en.t: there were tiny maki-e mirror stands and cabinets, shell-made folding screens, and eating bowls,

units.source_text: 纸灯笼、彩色的球，以及父亲的侧脸……

en.t: paper lanterns, colored balls, and even my father's profile...
